newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong's Regent buys cheap Gazprom stake -paper.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's Regent buys cheap Gazprom stake -paper.

text.p: Regent Pacific, the asset management group based in Hong Kong, has built a bargain basement stake in Russia's Gazprom GAZP.RTS, the world's largest natural gas company according to a Sunday Telegraph newspaper report.
The newspaper said Regent bought shares on the Russian domestic market at a fraction of the price of those in New York.
Last October saw the first international offering of 1.1 percent of Gazprom shares.

Gazprom had promised to protect the international price by keeping the much more numerous shares on the domestic market out of the hand of foreigners. These shares have been trading at less than a quarter of the U.S. price and it is these Regent has been buying, said The Sunday Telegrapah.
It said Regent had used a structure involving a Cayman Islands company which owns a Cyprus company which in turn owns a Russian company to build the stake.
